name: golf-booking-system
description: 高尔夫练习场-球道预约与教练排班管理系统

scripts.install:all: cd backend && go mod download && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c green,blue "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build:backend: cd backend && go build -o golf-server main.go
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c green,blue "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend"
